📌 Ethena takes USDe basis trade into tokenized US equities 

🔖 Ethena has added tokenized U.S. equities and equity perpetual futures to the basis trading strategy used for part of USDe’s backing, taking a funding model previously centered on crypto markets into listed stocks. According to a statement shared with cryptomedia, Ethena will use Binance’s bStocks as the spot side of the trade while taking offsetting positions through equity perpetual futures on the exchange. 

⭐️ The structure follows a framework previously approved by the Ethena Risk Committee for adding tokenized equity basis trades to the protocol’s allocation strategy. Ethena has historically used a delta neutral approach in crypto markets, pairing asset exposure with derivatives positions intended to hedge movements in the underlying asset. 

📊 Under the new setup, bStocks will provide tokenized equity exposure while Binance’s corresponding perpetual contracts will provide the hedge. The strategy seeks to capture the difference between the spot and perpetual markets without relying primarily on the direction of the underlying stock.

📄 Iran and Russia discuss opportunities for oil exploration cooperation in southern Caspian Sea

📌 Sari, IRNA – In a meeting with the ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Iran to Russia, the CEO of the Caspian Oil Company highlighted the potential for expanding exploration activities and developing hydrocarbon structures in the southern sector of the Caspian Sea.

Mohammad Hossein Daneshfar, CEO of the Caspian Oil Company, met and held discussions on Saturday with Kazem Jalali, the ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the Russian Federation, at the Iranian Embassy in Moscow.
​
Daneshfar, who has traveled to Russia to attend an international conference in St. Petersburg focused on shipbuilding and the design of advanced equipment for offshore oil and gas development, presented a report to the ambassador regarding the measures, activities, plans, and potential for oil and gas development in the Caspian region.
​
During the meeting, the two sides examined existing capacities and opportunities, exchanging views on strategies to expand exploration activities, develop hydrocarbon structures, and establish the necessary offshore infrastructure in the Caspian Sea.
​
Leveraging the strategic capabilities of the Caspian Sea and utilizing the potential of Russian companies in this vital energy region were also key topics of discussion.
​
This meeting was held to examine opportunities for expanding the oil and gas industry activities of the Islamic Republic of Iran in the southern Caspian Sea and to follow up on the existing potential in this region.

McDonald’s has rolled out a system that calculates how much people are willing to pay for a specific item.

It looks at millions of orders, competitors’ prices, and how customers respond to price increases. If people at one location are willing to pay more for a Big Mac without hesitation, the algorithm takes that into account.

A real-world example:
At two McDonald’s locations just 3 km apart, a Big Mac can cost $5.69 and $6.89. That’s a 21% difference.

Online retailers are already using the same approach: in the US, in 74% of cases, the same product is shown to different people at different prices.

AI takes into account purchase history, abandoned carts, time spent on a page, even mouse movements, and dozens of other factors.

According to research, personalized pricing is already generating 19% more profit for companies. So it looks like this is what sales will increasingly be built around.
